[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th January, 1985]
No. F. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information :-
3. Amendment of section 8, Act
XXXIV of 1974.-In the said Act, in section 8, after subsection (1), the
following new subsection shall be inserted, namely :--
"(1-A) Notwithstanding
anything contained in this Act,-
(a) out of three
additional seats in the National Assembly allocated to the Province of Sind by
virtue of the Delimitation of Constituencies (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985 two
shall be allocated to the districts comprising Karachi Division and one to the
district of Sukkur in accordance with the delimitation of revised
constituencies contained in Part `A' of the Schedule ; and
(b) the eleven
seats in the National Assembly allocated to the Province of Baluchistan shall
be allocated in accordance with the delimitation of revised constituencies
contained in Part `B' of the Schedule."
